name: app-tilted-phone-wall-scam-protection-thanks-slide
title: Tilted Phone Wall with Thank You
whatItIs: A tall pale-blue slide with a diagonal wall of tilted pastel phone screens fading toward the bottom, then huge 'THANK YOU FOR WATCHING' caps with a Follow chip, two QR codes, contact pills and a footer row of tags.
whatItMeans: A dense tilted field of screens fades into a bold sign-off, giving a satisfying end to a long story.
techniques: Grid of phones all rotated the same angle
Progressive fade of the screens into the background
Huge caps sign-off with a small Follow chip overlapping

vocabulary.definition: Many screens rotated identically and tiled.
Elements losing opacity toward an edge.
A rounded label holding an email or handle.
